subject: Action: vendor banking activation + virtual account / PO remittance mapping (Steelwave Logistics)
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@steelwave.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: finance@steelwave.com
Date: 2028-07-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Steelwave banking info + question on invoice splits

Hi Kimberly / Marissa,

Thanks again — we're ready to finalize payments setup so Redwood can start sending POs and the first payouts. Attached are the signed bank letter and our W-9. A couple quick items we need to confirm before you create the first PO: 

1) Steelwave uses one main operating account but often needs invoices split across three internal business units (ops, logistics, customs). Can Redwood route remittance strings so each invoice line maps to a specific cost center?

2) For recurring shipments we'd prefer a virtual-account-style remittance field (reference token) to auto-apply payments into our ledger. Do you support a virtual-account / reference field on ACH? If not, we can accept an ACH with a unique remit string per invoice (example attached).

Attached: Steelwave_W9.pdf, Steelwave_BankLetter_signed.pdf, PO_remit_example.csv

If easiest, happy to hop on a 20 min call tomorrow morning.

Best,
Alex Torres
Head of Finance Operations
Steelwave Logistics

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@steelwave.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-04T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Steelwave banking info + question on invoice splits

Alex — thanks for the docs, received and uploaded to the vendor folder. Quick answers up front: 

- We can support a remit reference per invoice (PO_INV format) for ACH and wire.
- Virtual-account-style routing (unique virtual account per cost center) is something our PayOps team can enable via a structured remittance token; it requires a brief mapping table and a one-time configuration on our side.

To move forward I need the following from you: 
- Confirm the three cost center codes you want (ops, logistics, customs) and the remit token you'd like for each (example in PO_remit_example.csv).
- Confirm whether Steelwave wants us to: 1) send a single ACH to your main account and rely on your post-processing to split; or 2) enable structured remit tokens so our system can tag payments during issuance (preferred for automated reconciliation).

Proposed next steps: 
- If option (2) is desired, Ben (copied) will set up the mapping and run a micro-deposit test this week. 
- If (1), we'll proceed to create the first PO and mark the remittance instructions in the PO note.

Can you confirm by EOD today? If yes, we'll schedule the micro-deposit and return a PO draft.

Thanks — kim

Kimberly Park
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@steelwave.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: finance@steelwave.com
Date: 2028-07-04T12:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Steelwave banking info + question on invoice splits

Kim — thanks for the quick response. We want option (2): structured remit tokens so Redwood's payment metadata maps automatically to our GL.

Cost center mapping (please use these exact codes):
- OPS -> SW-OPS-01
- LOG -> SW-LOG-03
- CUS -> SW-CUS-07

For the remit token please use format: PO{PO_NUMBER}-INV{INVOICE_NUMBER}-CC{COST_CENTER_CODE} (example: PO000452-INV00912-CCSW-LOG-03).

We confirm the attached bank letter is the account to receive ACH/wire. Also, let Ben know the two micro-deposit values we should expect for verification; we will confirm receipt and then provide the final authorization.

If you need a signed remittance SLA, we can send that via DocuSign — otherwise the bank letter and W9 should be sufficient to start micro-deposits.

Thanks,
Alex

From: ben_carter@redwood.com <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@steelwave.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-05T15:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Steelwave banking info + question on invoice splits

Alex — copied Jordan from PayOps for final config. We're set to enable structured remits using the token format you specified. Implementation notes / timeline: 

- Action items for Steelwave: please reply to this thread with the exact bank routing number and full account number (or confirm they're as per the bank letter). If you'd rather not send full account numbers by email, use the DocuSign link we shared and attach the signed bank letter there.
- Ben will kick off micro-deposits today (two test amounts between $0.05 and $0.99). Please confirm them in a reply to this thread once they land.
- Jordan will configure the mapping table and create a test PO in our sandbox tomorrow (we'll send a sandbox PO ID for you to use when confirming remits).

Expected timeline: micro-deposits today -> confirmation from Steelwave -> mapping enabled and sandbox test by 7/6 -> production PO and first payout by 7/9 assuming no issues.

I've attached a sample PO_remit_example.csv that shows how the token will appear on our payment file and on the remittance line of the PO.

If you'd like a 15-minute walkthrough of the sandbox flow, Jordan can run it — suggest 7/6 at 10:00 PT.

Thanks — Ben
Vendor Payments | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123
